limitations: Supervised RWF development experiment with a frozen Kinetics-400 encoder and logistic head. Released training footage supplies both fitting and source-grouped validation. The 400 released evaluation clips have already been inspected/scored in earlier transfer experiments, so this is exploratory development evaluation, not an untouched test claim or direct accuracy improvement over crowd-only transfer. Source IDs and byte hashes do not rule out renamed/shared footage. Independent labels and pretraining/source overlap remain unaudited. Scores are not calibrated.
